punnāga.p: [ puma + nāga. Pumanāmo nāgo rukkho punnāgo. Dhāna, ṭī. 556. Pumānāgoiva seṭṭho padhānattā so iva, thomanimi. ] (pu,na) CL=10 (m.) Punnag; Alexandrian Laurel tree.

P: Punnāga，[dial．?] a species of tree J．I，9 （°puppha）； VI，530； KhA 50 （aggacchinna°-phala），53 （id．）．（Page 467）

punnāga：ပုန္နာဂ （ပ）

DOP: punnāga m. [ S. puṃnāga], a tree, SAF: Alexandrian laurel (Calophyllum inophyllum L.); Abh 556 (~o tu ca kesaro); Ja I 425, 15 (°-gacchantaraṃ pavisitvā, Be, Se so; Ce papunnāga-; Ee °-gacchantare); VI 530, 2* (~ā giripunnāgā koviḷārā ca pupphitā) = Ap 16, 5 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se puṇṇāvā) ≠ 345, 30 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se puṇṇāgā); Ap 180, 3 (~aṃ pupphitaṃ disvā); Vism 256, 22 ( in cpd ); Th-a I 225, 25 (sugandhāni °-pupphāni ocinitvā); Vin-vn 1361 ( in cpd ); — see also giripunnāga.
